component.name: LINE GTK
component.summary: Unofficial native LINE client for Linux

description.p: LINE GTK is an unofficial GTK4 and Libadwaita desktop client that brings LINE chats and media to Linux.
It supports chats, media, stickers, friends, notifications, downloads, and experimental voice calls.
Adds hardened persistence and protocol recovery, offline packaging, diagnostics, virtualized conversations, modularized UI and protocol services, and Flatpak distribution.
